title: External cross-reference of 8 p85-relative extreme events (ERA5, Aug-Oct 2026) vs agency/news reports
convention: peak_value = ERA5 gridded daily-MEAN 2m T over bbox (station daily-MAX runs 4-8C higher); events are percentile-relative (p85 of 1990-2019); freeze event = t2m below local 15th percentile.

La stazione meteorologica urbana ha rilevato una temperatura minima notturna di 32,6 C, il valore piu alto mai misurato ad agosto ... Le analisi dell'Organizzazione Meteorologica Iraniana (IRIMO) ... cupola di alta pressione subtropicale
MIDDLE EAST HEAT WAVE Another extremely hot day with temperatures up to 51.2C at Omidieh, IRAN Records of August Highest MINIMUMS again: 38.0C Kuwait City 35.5C Abadan, IRAN
OIAG: Omidieh, Iran [44C] ... OIAW: Ahwaz, Iran [43C] ... OIAI: Masjed-Soleyman, Iran [42C] (METAR, 14 Aug 06Z)

events.notes: Our ERA5 daily-mean peak 41.57C is consistent with station daily maxima of 50-52C reported across southern Iran in the window (daily-mean vs daily-max offset). Afghanistan also in sustained heatwave conditions from early August (asia-news 2026-08-02: heatwave affecting Kabul, Balkh, Farah, Nimroz, Helmand). Iran Met Org (IRIMO) analysis cited in the 16 Aug report.

events.notes: SENAMHI-Peru officially warned of a heat wave (ola de calor) through Aug 31 exactly matching the window; record reports concentrated on coastal Peru/Lima, but the national advisory and selva-sector bulletins cover the bbox edge; Bolivia Aug summary shows widespread above-normal temperatures. 33.79C daily mean over W Amazon lowlands is a plausible anomaly in this context. No Brazil/INMET record report found specifically in-bbox.

sources.quote: Our office issued our latest Extreme Heat Warning on record during the September 1-5 heat wave ... It was the warmest September on record in Cape Girardeau and Poplar Bluff ... Paducah witnessing 13 days with a high temperature of 95 or greater which is a September record

events.notes: NWS in-window Extreme Heat Warning (Sep 1-5) named verbatim by the agency; heat continued mid-month (Heat Advisory Sep 15-19, latest on record). Our 33.8C ERA5 daily mean is consistent with station maxima of 95-104F during Sep 1-5.

sources.quote: In September 2026, the average monthly air temperature exceeded the climatic norm by 2.38 C, which corresponds to the 1st rank in a long-term series of observations. The previous maximum ... September 1957 ... positive anomalies ... observed throughout Kazakhstan

In the Urals, monthly averages have become a record since 1891 ... In the European part of the country ... the Russian North and in the Volga region, where the deviation reached 2-3 degrees

events.notes: No daily-level report found for Sep 8-11 specifically; month-scale agency evidence (Kazhydromet record-warm September, Russian Volga/Ural +2-3C) covers the window, so percentile-relative warmth of 24.77C daily mean is consistent but not independently confirmed at daily resolution.

sources.quote: According to 67.5% of meteorological stations ... the average monthly air temperature corresponded to the extremely high category ... values were among the 5% highest for the entire observation period

events.notes: Late-Decade-September Volga warmth (+20..+25C daily maxes in Nizhny Novgorod region, in bbox eastern edge) plus month-scale record warmth in the region is consistent context; no named daily record in-window found.

sources.quote: In southern Egypt earlier this week, thermometers climbed nearly 10 degrees above the September norm. Aswan set a new national record for the month ... Marsa Alam recorded 40C - around six degrees above the seasonal average ... Heat approaching the 50C mark was also recorded in northern Sudan
48.0C Aswan HOTTEST SEPTEMBER DAY EVER IN EGYPT 45.5C Abu Simbel 48C also in SUDAN Never happened anything like this anywhere in the world in mid September

Sudan experienced its warmest September on record ... Average temperatures during the month reached 32.79C, running 4C above the 1961-1990 baseline ... 2nd highest monthly temperature anomaly of all reported regions, trailing only South Sudan
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority (EMA) revealed that scorching heat will prevail across most parts of the country ... real-feel temperature in South Upper Egypt will reach 46C

events.notes: Mid-September Egypt/Sudan extreme heat with monthly national records (Aswan Egypt-record September max ~48C; Sudan warmest September on record). Our 39.66C ERA5 daily mean over the Sahara/Egypt/Sudan bbox is consistent. Heat persisted to ~Sep 27+ (EgyptToday 2026-09-29 reports subsidence).

sources.quote: Late-season heat affected southern China from September 25 into early October 2026 ... 39.5C in Qiaojia, Yunnan, 39.1C in Yongding, Fujian, and 38C in Guangxin, Jiangxi ... 19 stations set or tied late-September maximum-temperature records on September 30 ... 62 stations reportedly set or tied their highest October maximum temperatures [on Oct 1]

China Weather: widespread hot and humid conditions affected Jiangnan and southern China from September 25 to 30 under the influence of the western Pacific subtropical high (cited by The Watchers, 2026-10-03)
Beijing Climate Centre (CMA National Climate Centre) rapid attribution of August 2026 China heat: Northwest China anomaly 2.7 C (5.2 s.d.), new August record for the region

Hong Kong Observatory issued a Very Hot Weather Warning ... late-October temperatures soared to around 33 C ... record for the latest issuance of a Very Hot Weather Warning in a year ... Super El Nino altered tropical circulation patterns

events.notes: The Sep 25-Oct 2 late-September/'qiuhu' heat episode matches the window exactly (peak values at Qiaojia Yunnan etc. on Sep 28-30), with late-September station records and Oct 1-2 October records. CMA national June-Oct record context and HK late-October records corroborate the broader autumn-heat pattern. Our 32.56C daily mean over S/E China bbox is consistent.

sources.quote: October 2026 was the warmest October on record globally (15.35 C, +0.90 C vs 1991-2020) [reviewer-verified verbatim; the 'colder-than-average across Greenland' sentence originally quoted here does NOT appear in this bulletin - corrected, see reviewer_verification]

October 2026 was warmer than the 1991-2020 baseline over more than 90 percent of the Arctic ... The only large areas colder than normal were portions of Greenland [and] the northeastern-most Canadian Arctic.
Summit, Greenland | -44.2 C ... making it the coldest reporting location outside Antarctica in this observation period
Summit, Greenland Latest Conditions 2026-10-19 00:35:00 UTC Temperature -39.80 F [-39.9 C]

events.notes: Direct agency (C3S/ERA5) statement that Greenland was colder-than-average in Oct 2026, while the Arctic as a whole was record-warm; in-window Summit station readings (-39.9C Oct 19; -44.2C ~Oct 21) bracket our -43.69C ERA5 daily-mean cold extreme. Percentile-relative early-autumn deep cold over the high ice sheet - confirmed as below-normal, not a contradiction of the warm global context.
